description: Scrape hyperlocal US news from Patch.com. Search by keyword, browse the latest headlines for a town/city, or browse by category.

authorName.description: Exact byline/reporter/poster name (required for mode=byAuthor; on any other mode -- including events/classifieds -- it's applied as an extra filter, e.g. combine mode=search + searchQuery + authorName to search one reporter's own articles). Find it in the `author` field of any article/event/classified this actor returns, e.g. "Eric Heyl".
authorName.title: Author name

category.description: News category/topic to filter by (required for mode=byCategory; optional filter on mode=search/byTown/byAuthor/byTag). Not applicable to mode=events/classifieds -- use `classifiedCategory` for mode=classifieds instead.
category.title: Category

classifiedCategory.description: Classifieds category to filter by (mode=classifieds only; a completely separate value set from `category`, which is news-only). Leave as "(any category)" to browse every classified category.
classifiedCategory.title: Classified category

eventDateAfter.description: mode=events only. Only include events occurring on or after this date (the event's own date, not when it was posted to Patch -- see `publishedAfter` for that). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with `eventDateBefore` for a date range, e.g. "what's happening this weekend".
eventDateAfter.title: Event date after (YYYY-MM-DD)

eventDateBefore.description: mode=events only. Only include events occurring on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with `eventDateAfter` for a date range.
eventDateBefore.title: Event date before (YYYY-MM-DD)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of articles/events/classifieds to return.
maxItems.title: Max results

enumTitles: Browse latest news for a town/city
mode.title: Mode

nearLat.description: Latitude of a point to search near (combine with `nearLng` and `radiusMiles`). News modes only (search/byTown/byCategory/byAuthor/byTag) -- not available for mode=events/classifieds, whose Patch indexes don't expose a filterable location field. Both `nearLat` and `nearLng` must be set together; otherwise this filter is ignored.
nearLat.title: Near latitude

nearLng.description: Longitude of a point to search near (combine with `nearLat` and `radiusMiles`). News modes only -- see `nearLat` description. Both `nearLat` and `nearLng` must be set together; otherwise this filter is ignored.
nearLng.title: Near longitude

publishedAfter.description: Only include articles/events/classifieds posted to Patch on or after this date (i.e. listing date, not an event's own occurrence date -- see `eventDateAfter` for that). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with `publishedBefore` for a date range.
publishedAfter.title: Published after (YYYY-MM-DD)

publishedBefore.description: Only include articles/events/classifieds posted to Patch on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with `publishedAfter` for a date range.
publishedBefore.title: Published before (YYYY-MM-DD)

radiusMiles.description: Search radius around `nearLat`/`nearLng`, in miles. News modes only -- see `nearLat` description. Ignored unless both `nearLat` and `nearLng` are set.
radiusMiles.title: Radius (miles)

regionSlug.description: US state to scope results to (required for mode=byTown; optional scope filter on every other mode, including events/classifieds). Leave as "(any state)" for nationwide results.
regionSlug.title: State

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword to search for (mode=search; also applies as a keyword filter on mode=events/classifieds). Leave empty on other modes to browse without a keyword filter, or leave empty on mode=search to browse the newest articles matching the other filters below.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Order of results. "Nearest first" requires both `nearLat`/`nearLng` AND mode=search/byTown/byCategory/byAuthor/byTag (news); otherwise it falls back to Relevance. "Soonest event first" requires mode=events; on any other mode it also falls back to Relevance.
enumTitles: Nearest first (requires nearLat/nearLng, news modes only)
sortBy.title: Sort by

tagName.description: Exact editorial tag (required for mode=byTag; on mode=search/byTown/byCategory/byAuthor it's applied as an extra filter, e.g. combine mode=byCategory + category + tagName to browse one category narrowed to a tag). Find it in the `tags` field of any article this actor returns, e.g. "Back To School". Only a minority of articles carry tags, so run another mode first to discover one. Not applicable to mode=events/classifieds -- Patch doesn't tag those content types.
tagName.title: Tag name

townSlug.description: Patch town/city URL slug (required for mode=byTown; requires regionSlug too). Find it in a Patch URL, e.g. patch.com/california/santamonica -> "santamonica". Example: "santamonica" (with regionSlug=california).
townSlug.title: Town/city slug
